title: Living at Bechet's Brooklyn house and preparing the session
summary: Wilber moved in rent free, rehearsed the Wildcats there, and recalls an earlier nervous Commodore date and the subway trip.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology
